_comment: The books run each morning. Each is fully independent: its own universe, priority ranking, config, equity curve, scan output and PDF. Adding a third means adding an entry here and nothing else.
_capital: Each book carries the FULL account equity rather than a share of it, deliberately. The binding constraint is the stop, not the cash: positions are leveraged, so 6 slots in each book is 12 positions and about 4% of equity at risk when both are full, with notional up to roughly 200%. That is a leverage decision, taken knowingly - halve `equity` in both configs to run them as two halves of one account instead.

data_refresh._comment: Fills the price cache from IB Gateway before the books run, writing the same files the Yahoo loaders read. Failure is NOT fatal: the pipeline carries on against the existing cache, because a missing gateway should degrade the data, not cancel the morning. Set enabled false to go back to Yahoo only.
data_refresh._skip_current: Phase 1 fetches only symbols whose cache does not already reach the last completed session. On a 05:30 run nothing does yet, so everything is fetched; on a re-run or after an interruption almost nothing is, which is what makes re-running the morning cheap instead of another 43 minutes.
data_refresh._prices: TRADES, not ADJUSTED_LAST: signals are computed on prices that actually traded, so the gate matches the chart. Dividend adjustment lowers a year of history and the EMA200 with it - HBH.DE reads 80.86 adjusted against 82.66 raw, and the arming decision flips on exactly that. 5 Y so the EMA200 is well converged.

_tv_chart: Symbols in the reports link here with ?symbol= appended. Put the slug of your !AKTIEN_ANALYSE layout in it - open that layout in TradingView and copy the URL, which looks like https://www.tradingview.com/chart/AbCd1234/. Without a slug this opens whichever layout you used last, which is usually right but not guaranteed.
